purpose: Move the specimen update instant from a lexical representation to a native timezone-aware database primitive through a reversible compatibility window.

phase_sequence.purpose: Add the native instant column and compatibility trigger with a bounded metadata lock.
preconditions: Source schema digest matches the reviewed baseline
Flyway reports active PostgreSQL schema-history coordination for this migration
success_criteria: Native instant column exists with the reviewed type
Application writes remain available within the lock budget

phase_sequence.purpose: Populate native instants in restartable batches and retain a durable high-water mark.
preconditions: Expand phase checkpoint matches the reviewed plan
success_criteria: Every eligible row carries one parsed native instant
Batch replay returns the same row values and checkpoint

phase_sequence.purpose: Prove lexical and native projections converge for the representative cohort.
preconditions: Backfill checkpoint covers the selected cohort
success_criteria: Temporal parity and domain checks pass
Constraint validation completes within the statement budget

phase_sequence.purpose: Route reads to the native instant while retaining the verified legacy projection for recovery.
preconditions: Validation receipt reports a passing reconciliation
success_criteria: Application reads use the native instant
Compatibility health checks pass for both supported releases

phase_sequence.purpose: Retire the legacy projection after the observed compatibility window and accountable approval.
preconditions: Compatibility observation reaches the reviewed duration
Contract-phase approval binds the passing evidence bundle
success_criteria: Target schema digest matches the release manifest

writer_coordination.strategy: Flyway coordinates one migration writer through its schema-history mechanism.
writer_coordination.evidence: The governed receipt preserves Flyway validate and migrate outcomes together with the exact public.flyway_schema_history relation inspected after execution.

execution_policy.schema_drift_check: The release gate compares the live schema digest with the reviewed source digest before Flyway starts the first phase.

contract_phase_entry_criteria: Dual-version health and temporal parity receipts pass
Scientific, Quality, Regulatory, Security, and Operations roles review one evidence bundle

recovery.containment: The release coordinator pauses before the next migration and keeps the verified projection available at the last durable checkpoint.
recovery.replacement_behavior: The owner resumes the idempotent phase or restores the reviewed recovery point according to the recorded disposition.
recovery.verification: A second operator executes the selected route and confirms schema, record, and application health.
